verdict.rationale: There's scattered evidence of third-party integration (IDE assistants like Cursor/Claude Code recommended to load 'Gemini API Skills', and community mention of OpenRouter routing to Gemini) but no evidence of curated community lists, active third-party tool maintainers, or a broader ecosystem narrative — most evidence is first-party docs. missing for 10: curated awesome-lists, evidence of active third-party maintainers/tools beyond OpenRouter, community-run integration projects, hackathon/plugin ecosystem signals.
